sub: Card states at the issuer, from request to cancellation. Each change generates an event and is recorded in the `cartao` table. Happy path: Requested, In production, In transit, Awaiting activation, Active.

states.name: Requested
states.desc: The customer requested the card in the app. No physical card exists yet.

states.name: In production
states.desc: The order was sent to the card manufacturer; the number and cryptogram already exist.

states.name: In transit
states.desc: The manufacturer handed the card to the postal service with a tracking number.

states.name: Awaiting activation
states.desc: The card reached the customer but cannot accept purchases.

states.name: Blocked
states.desc: The customer blocked the card in the app. It returns to Active when unblocked.

states.name: Canceled
states.desc: Cannot return to a previous state. The number is not reused.

states.name: Lost in transit
states.desc: The postal service returned or lost the shipment. This is terminal; the manufacturer issues a new card with a new number.

band.f1: An incorrect PIN during activation does not change the state; only the third failed attempt moves the card to Blocked.
band.f2: Out of scope: virtual cards, replacements for damage and credit cards.
